LCritical non-compliance flagsTick each flag observed and explain it under key findings

  • Centre closed or no class during scheduled hours
  • Trainer absent or replaced by an unapproved person
  • Trainees on register / TMS but not present (possible ghost trainees)
  • Proxy or advance attendance marking
  • Existing employees, or trainees of non-SICIP courses, enrolled in SICIP courses
  • Fees charged to trainees
  • Required tools and equipment missing or unused
  • Facility used at the same time for another program's training
  • Graduate reported as job-placed in TMS but not employed
